note: Public prices and rates only. 'observed' = the page was fetched and the number seen on 2026-11-14. 'estimated' = neutral estimate, band computed by the same rule for every site (see estimateMethod). Nothing here is a quote.

estimateMethod.text: Where no sourced figure was fetched, a single analyst reference point is stated and the band is reference x 0.4 / x 1.0 / x 2.5 (cost) or x 0.6 / x 1.0 / x 1.6 (equipment rating). The reference point is a stated judgement, not a source; the same rule is applied to every site and no value is tuned to favor a site.

operatingAssumptions.rationale: Operating hours and duty cycles are stated assumptions (no site operating plan exists). BTU per Mcf is a typical natural gas heat content.
